**5B.8 Research Note**
Overall, Lula’s 2024 economic distribution record is **moderately positive but uneven**. The clearest positives are broad regional development, anti-poverty gains, gender-equality labor measures, Indigenous/quilombola land and inclusion steps, and heavy PAC spending in poorer and lower-service areas. The main negatives are persistent racialized police violence, ongoing Indigenous crisis conditions, and the fact that many positive items are official policy announcements rather than independent delivery audits. I found **no strong direct evidence** that economic gains were systematically reserved for regime supporters, but the implementation gap is real.

**Positive Evidence**
- [Governo Federal promulga decreto para fortalecer desenvolvimento regional e reduzir desigualdades no país](https://www.gov.br/mdr/pt-br/noticias/governo-federal-promulga-decreto-para-fortalecer-desenvolvimento-regional-e-reduzir-desigualdades-no-pais) — Ministério da Integração e do Desenvolvimento Regional, 2024-03-26. Lula signed a regional-development policy explicitly aimed at reducing intra- and interregional disparities, which is direct evidence of a fairness-oriented distribution strategy across regions. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.6.
- [Novo PAC Seleções vai investir R$ 23 bilhões em saúde, educação, esporte e cultura](https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/marco/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-23-bilhoes-em-saude-educacao-esporte-e-cultura) — Casa Civil, 2024-03-07. The program targeted low-coverage areas with health, education, sport, and culture investments, pointing to broader distribution beyond already-advantaged regions. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.6.
- [Novo PAC Seleções vai investir R$ 41,7 bi em transporte, drenagem, esgotamento sanitário, abastecimento de água e infraestrutura social nas cidades](https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/julho/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-41-7-bi-em-transporte-drenagem-esgotamento-sanitario-abastecimento-de-agua-e-infraestrutura-social-nas-cidades) — Casa Civil, 2024-07-26. This is direct evidence of infrastructure spending aimed at cities’ basic services, which tends to benefit lower-income areas more than elite enclaves. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.6.
- [FNDE e MEC formalizam investimentos para retomada de obras e Novo PAC durante Marcha dos Prefeitos](https://www.gov.br/fnde/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/fnde-e-mec-formalizam-investimentos-para-retomada-de-obras-e-novo-pac-durante-marcha-dos-prefeitos) — FNDE/MEC, 2024-05-22. Lula’s government restarted stalled education works and funded school buses, creches, and schools, which is broad-based class and regional equalization through public-service access. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.6.
- [Decreto nº 12.049, de 11 de junho de 2024](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12049.htm) — Presidência da República, 2024-06-11. The “Mais Ciência na Escola” program expands digital technologies, STEAM learning, teacher training, and innovation labs, supporting more equal access to future-oriented human capital. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.6.
- [Novo PAC: novas estratégias para auxiliar estados e municípios na construção de unidades de saúde](https://www.gov.br/saude/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/novembro/novo-pac-novas-estrategias-para-auxiliar-estados-e-municipios-na-construcao-de-unidades-de-saude/) — Ministério da Saúde, 2024-11-14. The ministry lowered execution barriers for UBS construction, which should help poorer municipalities more than richer ones. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.6.
- [Governo federal lança plano com 79 ações para promover a igualdade salarial e laboral entre mulheres e homens](https://www.gov.br/mulheres/pt-br/central-de-conteudos/noticias/2024/setembro/governo-federal-lanca-plano-com-79-acoes-para-promover-a-igualdade-salarial-e-laboral-entre-mulheres-e-homens) — Ministério das Mulheres, 2024-09-18. This is direct evidence of gender-based redistribution and labor-market equalization rather than privileged treatment of a narrow bloc. QIDs: 5B.8.
- [Governo federal destina mais de 120 mil hectares a 4,5 mil quilombolas](https://www.gov.br/igualdaderacial/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/governo-federal-destina-mais-de-120-mil-hectares-a-4-5-mil-quilombolas) — Ministério da Igualdade Racial, 2024-09-19. Land titling broadens access to productive assets for a historically excluded Black rural group, directly supporting cross-group fairness. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.4.
- [Casa Civil apresenta medidas implementadas na Terra Yanomami à Corte Interamericana de Direitos Humanos](https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/maio/casa-civil-apresenta-medidas-implementadas-na-terra-yanomami-a-corte-interamericana-de-direitos-humanos/) — Casa Civil, 2024-05-23. Presenting remediation to an external rights body is evidence of trying to repair severe exclusion affecting an Indigenous population, not privileging regime supporters. QIDs: 5B.8.
- [Taxa de desmatamento na Amazônia cai 30,6% e 25,7% no Cerrado](https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/taxa-de-desmatamento-na-amazonia-cai-30-6-e-25-7-no-cerrado) — Ministério do Meio Ambiente e INPE, 2024-11-06. Lower deforestation indirectly benefits Indigenous, rural, and riverine communities exposed to land conflict and environmental predation. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.6.

**Negative Evidence / Caveats**
- [Brazil World Report 2025](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/brazil) — Human Rights Watch, 2025-01-01, covering 2024 events. HRW reported 4,565 police killings by September 2024, with more than 80% of victims Black, showing that gains were not being distributed fairly in practice for Black Brazilians. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.4.
- [Brazil should comply with Inter-American Court rulings on police killings](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/15/brazil-comply-rulings-police-violence) — Human Rights Watch, 2024-03-15. HRW said lethal raids, unlawful force, intimidation, and evidence tampering continued in poor and Black communities, which is strong counterevidence to fair distribution. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.4.
- [Brazil mixed rights record, Lula’s first year](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/brazil-mixed-rights-record-lulas-first-year) — Human Rights Watch, 2024-01-11. HRW explicitly noted that police abuse still disproportionately affected Black Brazilians, so the social dividend was not evenly shared across classes and races. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.4.
- [World Report 2024: Brazil](https://freedomhouse.org/country/brazil/freedom-world/2024) — Freedom House, 2024. Freedom House still found disproportionate violence, economic exclusion of minorities, and serious discrimination against LGBT+ people, limiting any claim of broadly fair distribution. QIDs: 5B.8.
- [Crise do povo Yanomami persiste após 308 mortes em 2023, diz relatório](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/01/26/crise-do-povo-yanomami-persiste-apos-308-mortes-em-2023-diz-relatorio.htm) — Reuters via UOL, 2024-01-26. Yanomami leaders said the crisis remained severe, with continued invasion, malnutrition, disease, and violence; that is direct counterevidence that vulnerable groups had been made safe or included in gains. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.6.
- [Lula envia ao Congresso mensagem de calamidade no RS para excetuar gastos de resultado fiscal](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/05/06/lula-envia-ao-congresso-mensagem-de-calamidade-no-rs-para-excetuar-gastos-de-resultado-fiscal.htm) — Reuters via UOL, 2024-05-06. The disaster exemption was understandable, but it shows distributive flexibility for a politically salient state, not a fully neutral rule set. QIDs: 5B.8, 5B.6, 5B.4.

**Search Gap**
- I found **substantial evidence of broad-based redistribution by region, class, gender, race, and Indigenous status**, but much of it comes from official program announcements rather than independent outcome audits.
- I found **little direct evidence that Lula explicitly favored regime supporters in distributing economic gains**; the main negatives are instead persistent structural inequality, especially for Black Brazilians, Indigenous communities, and the poor.
- So the most defensible read is: **Lula’s 2024 economic policy was explicitly redistribution-oriented and broadly inclusive, but real-world equality of gains remained incomplete and uneven.**
